Record Class ReportRepository.SalesReport

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.squad93.pos.db.ReportRepository.SalesReport
Record Components:
from - inclusive first sales date
to - inclusive last sales date
items - menu item sales in report order
Enclosing class:
ReportRepository
public static record ReportRepository.SalesReport(LocalDate from, LocalDate to, List<ReportRepository.ItemSales> items) extends Record
Menu item sales in an inclusive date range. The repository query supplies items in descending combined-revenue order.
